He is an 18-year-old U.S. citizen born and raised in Chicago who is battling stage 4 colon cancer; he was diagnosed in January 2026. His brother, Jovany Ramirez, has been his caretaker these last few months. In the early morning hours of May 2, as Cindy was getting her hair and makeup done for her sweet sixteen, her mother, Cindy Landero, waited for her in the car when they received a call that her father, Cesar Cortez, had been pulled over at a gas station and taken into custody by immigration authorities.
